# security-triage

> A confidence-gated security triage skill for AI coding agents. Six tracks: CVE and scanner
> alerts, source code, LLM applications, CI/CD workflows, containers and infrastructure, and
> exposed credentials. Classifies LLM findings against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
> 2026 (LLM01-LLM10) and the Agentic Top 10 (ASI01-ASI10). Applies a HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW confidence gate before assigning severity, so
> findings that are not exploitable are suppressed into a notes section instead of reported.

The skill is plain markdown with YAML frontmatter. It works as a `SKILL.md` where that
convention exists (Claude Code, claude.ai, plugin runtimes) and as a system prompt or rules
file everywhere else. Nothing to compile, no network access, no dependencies.

What makes it different from a scanner or a generic "act as a security expert" prompt: every
finding must survive a three-part gate — vulnerable pattern confirmed, attacker-controlled
input confirmed, exploitable in the stated context. Anything that fails is not reported as a
finding. Output is a fixed structure: FINDING, CLASSIFICATION, WHAT IS THIS, AM I AFFECTED,
IMPACT, BLIND SPOTS, THE FIX (as a diff), VERIFY IT'S FIXED, REFERENCES, ACTION.

## Skill

- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/S3DFX-CYBER/Claude-Skills-Security/main/skills/security-triage/SKILL.md): the complete methodology — confidence gate, six tracks, per-language sink tables, CVSS 3.1 construction, report format, action mapping and disclosure path, repo-scale mode

## Docs

- [README.md](https://github.com/S3DFX-CYBER/Claude-Skills-Security/blob/main/README.md): what it is, the gate, install for every runtime
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/S3DFX-CYBER/Claude-Skills-Security/blob/main/AGENTS.md): agent discovery, invocation contract, track routing, GitHub MCP workflow
- [COMPATIBILITY.md](https://github.com/S3DFX-CYBER/Claude-Skills-Security/blob/main/COMPATIBILITY.md): per-runtime configuration and local model guidance
- [install.sh](https://github.com/S3DFX-CYBER/Claude-Skills-Security/blob/main/install.sh): universal installer — `./install.sh claude|cursor|codex|copilot|gemini|aider|cline|zed|continue|print`

## Examples

- [examples/02-false-positive/output.md](https://github.com/S3DFX-CYBER/Claude-Skills-Security/blob/main/examples/02-false-positive/output.md): six scanner flags, zero findings, with the reason for each — the most useful single file for understanding the gate
- [examples/01-ci-cd-rce/output.md](https://github.com/S3DFX-CYBER/Claude-Skills-Security/blob/main/examples/01-ci-cd-rce/output.md): a full HIGH-confidence report on a `pull_request_target` workflow
- [examples/03-llm-rag/output.md](https://github.com/S3DFX-CYBER/Claude-Skills-Security/blob/main/examples/03-llm-rag/output.md): three Track C findings with a summary table

## Evals

- [evals/README.md](https://github.com/S3DFX-CYBER/Claude-Skills-Security/blob/main/evals/README.md): protocol for scoring the skill — recall, false-positive rate, track accuracy, severity agreement
- [evals/expected.yaml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/S3DFX-CYBER/Claude-Skills-Security/main/evals/expected.yaml): ground truth for 12 labelled cases, 6 positive and 6 negative
